w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Redactor.

w3Mentions.name: The Focus Group
w3Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Chris just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

w3Mentions.name: Spool
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🐗 RAID — 5 raiders (Big Loud, Ugly-Bane, Ugly-Bane, Spool, Night Court) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! The palisade's stakes take their toll as they come over the wall.

w3Mentions.name: Chorus Line
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🐗 RAID — 5 raiders (Big Big, Loud-Eyes, The Suburb, Big Loud, Chorus Line) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! The palisade's stakes take their toll as they come over the wall.

w3Mentions.name: The Callback
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Callback.

w3Mentions.name: Buffering
w3Mentions.firstLine: 💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Buffering: Stand still. It aims where you will be. Give it nothing to predict and it whiffs. (Carlos lived to tell it, twice — the village pieced it together.)

w3Mentions.name: Ad Break
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — Ad Break.

w5Mentions.name: The Editor
w5Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. The Editor is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)
firstContext: 🍖 FEAST 📺 — Agnese opens the pantry wide: 8× Foraged food. Nora, Diego, Priya eat until the fire burns low. The laughter stays low — somebody's seat is empty, and everybody sees it. For one evening, grief sits at the fire with them instead of standing over them. (−1,600 kcal from the pantry) The c
🍖 FEASTED ×2.25 until tomorrow's dawn (6 parts left): a simple feast. A channeled keepsake feeds the flames (devotion ×1.5). Arc IV burns hotter. Strikes and abilities hit with the feast behind them.

🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. The Editor is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)
The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.
You don't know what that was. Scissors, and the world getting shorter. Someone at the haven should hear about this.

w5Mentions.name: The Rerun
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📖 Codex: Rerun — locks onto one target — moving won't dodge it. You won't forget this.
firstContext: 💥 The attack finds you — no dodging it.
The attack hits you for 9.
📖 Codex: Rerun — locks onto one target — moving won't dodge it. You won't forget this.
(stripes flowing where no wind blows's hide absorbs 1.)
You STRIKE the stripes flowing where no wind blows for 14.

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: 🧳 A traveler passed through yesterday, talking about a village to the southeast called Stonebridge. The region is bigger than your fire.
📋 SYSTEM QUEST: "Teach us? Show us a plant you know COMPLETELY (Codex L3) — 26 candidates in your notes. We will watch very closely. Reward: integration."
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
Rain. Steady, cold, honest rain.
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. The spiral has started.

w5Mentions.name: The Commercial Break
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 Scouts found the broadcast tower — tile 4,1. THE FINALE does not arrive alone: first, its crew. THE COMMERCIAL BREAK (node 1 of 3). Kill the production staff and the finale airs without a safety net — no one left to call "cut." The march needs 20 allied blades. Sound the call.
firstContext: ✦ Ines has found something — Fever's End. Days of field_medicine and herbal_remedy side by side, and now they move as one. (fevers_end: villager synergy discovered)
🪤 TRAP: Your Snare 4 tiles north-east caught a Gray Squirrel! — set it, waited, and the old way worked. About 350 kcal on the bone — clean it quickly (knife). It rots fast.

📺 Scouts found the broadcast tower — tile 4,1. THE FINALE does not arrive alone: first, its crew. THE COMMERCIAL BREAK (node 1 of 3). Kill the production staff and the finale airs without a safety net — no one left to call "cut." The march needs 20 allied blades. Sound the call.
🌪️ THE FINALE struck Emberhold in the night. They bled while the coalition talked. (trust −5 — they notice who wasn't there.)
— DAY 88 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.

w5Mentions.name: The Network Note
w5Mentions.firstLine: ⚔ THE NETWORK NOTE! You're on your own.
firstContext: 📺 SYSTEM: "3 gates. 3 waves. The crowd is a held breath."
You don't know what that was. A memo, cc'd to the sky. Someone at the haven should hear about this.
⚔ THE NETWORK NOTE! You're on your own.
Turn-based now. Tap a tile to move — speed is squares. Then act.
📺 SYSTEM: "COMBAT! THE NETWORK NOTE! The gamblers lean in. ROUND 1 — FIGHT!"

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A full seat. global standing, every wave faced, the deeds complete. The table rises when you enter. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 4 · Forage 23 · Craft 12 · Talk 18 · Explore 44 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
noticeLines: ◈ THE SYSTEM — "NOTICED. YOUR REGISTER IS SHIFTING TENDER — YOU TEACH MORE THAN YOU TAKE. I AM... KEEPING UP. BARELY. DO NOT SLOW DOWN ON MY ACCOUNT."
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; the relay carried faithfully. The light road is open.

ladderLines.line: 🍖 THE BUNDLE — no feast tonight, no guests: 8,352 kcal of pantry stores bought the bundle outright. Six different gifts, paid for in food. The ladder counts it.
It wants the job itself: caretaking, as a practice. This is the ask the whole ladder was climbing toward.

✨ CAPSTONE: Seed Vault. Every seed you have ever pocketed, kept dry and dreaming. It weighs almost nothing. Almost. It was never going to drop from a monster. It was always going to be GIVEN — to someone who'd earned the shape of it.
